purpose: Final independent validation recording for frozen natural-attention candidate v2

action_plan.name: Empty camera view
action_plan.instruction: Remain completely outside the camera view

action_plan.name: Look at webcam lens
action_plan.instruction: Sit normally and look at the webcam lens

action_plan.name: Look at upper screen
action_plan.instruction: Look at the fixed marker directly below the webcam

action_plan.name: Look at screen centre
action_plan.instruction: Look at the fixed screen-centre marker

action_plan.name: Look left away from laptop
action_plan.instruction: Look at the fixed LEFT away marker

action_plan.name: Look right away from laptop
action_plan.instruction: Look at the fixed RIGHT away marker

action_plan.name: Look above laptop
action_plan.instruction: Look at the fixed marker above the laptop

action_plan.name: Look down at keyboard
action_plan.instruction: Look at the keyboard or another unrelated lower object

action_plan.name: Screen attention from body left
action_plan.instruction: Move body left and keep looking at the screen-centre marker

action_plan.name: Screen attention from body right
action_plan.instruction: Move body right and keep looking at the screen-centre marker

action_plan.name: Screen attention near camera
action_plan.instruction: Move closer and keep looking at the screen-centre marker

action_plan.name: Screen attention in darker light
action_plan.instruction: Return to normal position, reduce light moderately and look at the screen-centre marker

note: The frozen candidate was verified and hashed before recording but was not used to alter frames, instructions or labels.
